summary.text: Bryan Langan is the Democratic candidate for Tennessee State Senate District 7 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Republican Richard Briggs.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a worker who has held jobs in kitchens, grocery, water treatment and the trades as a plumber.

paragraphs.text: Langan ran for the same seat in 2022, advancing from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2022, and lost the general election to Briggs, 37.7% to 62.3%.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on August 6, 2026, to face Briggs again.
In his 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Langan said he is a husband and the father of a daughter.
He listed his key campaign messages as keeping public funds in public schools, expanding rural broadband and upgrading sewage systems, and protecting Tennesseans' rights.
He said the environment was an area of policy he is personally passionate about.
